 Your anterior (front tooth) composite filling has been completed using a tooth-colored restorative material designed to restore the appearance, function, and strength of your tooth. Following these instructions will help ensure the longevity of your restoration.

Immediately After the Procedure

🦷 Post Extraction Tips for a Smooth Recovery 🦷
By Dr. Sakshi Jain | Vital Dental Clinic

Getting a tooth removed can feel uncomfortable, but proper care after extraction helps you heal faster and avoid complications. Here are some simple and important tips to follow after your tooth extraction:

✅ Bite gently on the gauze pad for 30–45 minutes to control bleeding. Slight oozing is normal for a few hours.

✅ Avoid spitting, rinsing, or using a straw for the first 24 hours. This can disturb the blood clot and delay healing.

✅ Take prescribed medicines exactly as advised by your dentist. Do not skip painkillers or antibiotics if prescribed.

✅ Do not smoke or drink alcohol after extraction, as it slows healing and increases infection risk.

✅ Maintain oral hygiene carefully. Brush gently and avoid the extraction area for the first day. After 24 hours, rinse gently with warm salt water 2–3 times daily.
